WITH selected_buildings AS ( SELECT osm_type, osm_id, footprint, height_m, min_height_m, levels, source_updated_at, imported_at,
AS normalized_height,
AS normalized_height_source FROM gis.building WHERE ST_DWithin( footprint::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)::geography, #{radius} ) ), geojson_features AS ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'Feature', 'id', osm_type || '/' || osm_id, 'properties', jsonb_strip_nulls( jsonb_build_object( 'buildingId', osm_type || '/' || osm_id, 'heightMeters', normalized_height, 'heightEstimated', normalized_height_source <> 'height', 'minHeightMeters', NULLIF(min_height_m, 0) ) ), 'geometry', ST_AsGeoJSON(footprint)::jsonb ) AS feature, GREATEST(source_updated_at, imported_at) AS data_updated_at FROM selected_buildings ) SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'FeatureCollection', 'features', COALESCE(jsonb_agg(feature), '[]'::jsonb), 'metadata', jsonb_build_object( 'source', 'OpenStreetMap / PostgreSQL / PostGIS', 'attribution', '© OpenStreetMap contributors', 'timestamp', to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'), 'dataUpdatedAt', COALESCE( to_char(MAX(data_updated_at) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'), '' ), 'radius', #{radius}, 'buildingCount', COUNT(*) ) )::text FROM geojson_features
